en: Black‑and‑white aerial view of a small town dominated by a large medieval stone church surrounded by trees. The church has a steep gabled roof and a separate wooden belfry with a pointed roof. Around it lie wooden houses, a larger multi‑storey building in the foreground, open fields and farmland in the distance. In the bottom left corner the word "LOHJA" and the number "2760" are printed.
